scope: Advisory physical/perturbation closure audit only; no solver, fit, or change to campaign claims.

model.name: Interacting vacuum, w_x=-1, Q=Gamma*rho_x
model.background_sign_convention: dot(rho_x)=+Q; dot(rho_c)+3H*rho_c=-Q; Gamma>0 transfers CDM to vacuum.
model.campaign_screen_scope: Background BAO only; radiation/neutrinos/early sound horizon/perturbations omitted; z<=2.33.

equations.check: Positive Gamma is CDM->vacuum; negative Gamma is vacuum->CDM. Gamma has inverse-time units.

equations.source: S1 plus covariant interpretation checked against S2 and S3
equations.locator: S1 PDF pp. 4-5, Eqs. (19)-(20), and sentence 'no momentum transfer in the DM rest frame'; S2 sections 2.1-2.3
equations.status: Operational closure implied by source perturbation equations, not a printed standalone covariant law or a microphysical action. Source §II.A says no fundamental framework uniquely fixes Q generally. Sign convention here reproduces E1. The geodesic/potential-flow approximation is for linear scalar work, not a generic nonlinear halo model.

equations.locator: arXiv:1902.10694v2, §2.3, especially Eqs. (15)-(19) and explanatory text
equations.check: Vacuum homogeneous only on the geodesic-CDM-comoving slicing; do not assert delta_V=0 in all gauges.

equations.locator: PDF Eqs. (14), (19), (20), pp. 4-5; metric and variables defined immediately there
equations.check: Use conformal-time prime; in CDM-comoving synchronous gauge theta_c=0 by residual gauge choice, leaving delta_c'=-h'/2+a*Gamma*(V/rho_c)*delta_c.

For t<t0 and Gamma<0, require rho_c0>|Gamma|*integral(t,t0)[a^3*V dt'] for strict CDM positivity. For t>t0 and Gamma>0, require rho_c0>Gamma*integral(t0,t)[a^3*V dt']. V stays positive for finite t if V0>0.

implementation_gates.paper_status: Partly specified: no CDM-rest-frame momentum transfer and IVS equations given; standalone covariant form/action not shown.

implementation_gates.required: Use synchronous CDM-comoving variables, fix residual theta_c=0, enforce delta_V(comoving_c)=0, and transform/report gauge-dependent outputs correctly.
implementation_gates.paper_status: Synchronous gauge and equations specified; residual-gauge/initialization detail should be explicit in reproducer.

implementation_gates.required: Integrate full H(a) with conserved baryons, photons/radiation, and massive/massless neutrinos; document physical densities, T_CMB, neutrino hierarchy, recombination/helium and sound-horizon calculation.
implementation_gates.paper_status: Source Eq. (3) includes components; fixes sum_m_nu=0.06 eV and N_eff=3.044; modified CAMB and Planck likelihood named. Exact all-code configuration is not given in article prose.

implementation_gates.required: State regular adiabatic growing-mode conditions for photon, baryon, CDM and neutrino sectors, their consistency with the vacuum constraint, start redshift/k*tau, and whether isocurvature modes are excluded.
implementation_gates.paper_status: No explicit IVS initial-condition formula/prescription found in the source article text.

implementation_gates.required: Require rho_c>0, V>0, H^2>0 and finite perturbation solutions over the complete early-to-late integration interval; test Gamma=0 recovery, both signs, ODE/solver tolerance, start epoch and k convergence.
implementation_gates.paper_status: Source paper scans Gamma/H0 in [-3,3] for IVS; a Gamma sign cut is stated only for w_x != -1 branches. No global IVS component-positivity guarantee is stated.

implementation_gates.required: Retain Einstein metric constraints, photon/baryon tight coupling and recombination, neutrino free-streaming/shear hierarchy, primordial spectrum, lensing/reionization and exact Planck/growth likelihood configurations.
implementation_gates.paper_status: Source says modified CAMB and Cobaya; no versioned model patch or all initialization/config details identified in article prose.

stability_and_sign_findings.gamma_positive: CDM->vacuum for S1 convention; rho_c is guaranteed positive backwards in time from positive rho_c0 by the exact comoving-density identity, but may reach zero in the future.
stability_and_sign_findings.gamma_negative: Vacuum->CDM for S1 convention; rho_c grows forward from positive rho_c0, but can cross zero at sufficiently early times unless the explicit past integral bound holds.
stability_and_sign_findings.vacuum_density: If V0>0 and Gamma is finite/constant, V(t)>0 for every finite t.
stability_and_sign_findings.perturbation_singularity: The coefficient Gamma*rho_x/rho_c in S1's CDM density equation diverges as rho_c approaches zero; positivity is required, not merely H^2>0.
stability_and_sign_findings.fluid_instability_caveat: S1 gives the large-scale stability wedges w_x<-1,Gamma/H0<0 for phantom and w_x>-1,Gamma/H0>0 for quintessence. These are not a sign theorem for w_x=-1 IVS; no DE fluid sound speed exists in the chosen vacuum closure.
stability_and_sign_findings.microphysical_stability: No action is supplied, so ghost/gradient/UV stability of a fundamental completion cannot be inferred from this phenomenological system.
